title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 神將祂的話語放在我們口中，為了透過我們的宣告，在地上建立屬天的根基並呼喚出人的命定。
lines: And here's what He says following this.
This is actually where I wanted to go.
這其實是我想要講的重點。
So verse 15 says, "I am the Lord your God, who divided the sea, whose waves roared—the Lord of hosts is His name."
所以第十五節說：「我是耶和華你的神，攪動大海，使海中的波浪匉訇，萬軍之耶和華是我的名。」

Verse 16, "And I have put my words in your mouth, I have covered you with the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundation of the earth, and say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"
第十六節：「我將我的話傳給你，用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽定諸天，立定地基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。」
I've put my Spirit upon you, I've put my words in your mouth, I've put my Spirit upon you, I've covered you with my hand.
我將我的靈降在你們身上，我將我的話放在你們口中，我將我的靈降在你們身上，我用我的手遮蔽你們。
The Lord protects what He blesses.
Do you remember this passage? It says, "And His favor surrounds me like a shield."
你們記得這段經文嗎？上面說：「祂的恩惠如同盾牌四面護衛我。」
That's because He protects what He blesses.
那是因為祂保護祂所賜福的。
He doesn't bless and then leave it to be devoured.
祂不會在賜福之後，就任憑其被吞吃。
Opposite—He blesses, and then He surrounds with protection.
恰恰相反——祂賜福，然後祂以保護四面環繞。
So here we have the Lord saying, "All right, I'm the one who put my word in your mouth."
所以在這裡，我們看到主說：「好的，我是將我的話放在你口中的那一位。」
And what did He do then?
"I put my hand over you, I've covered you with the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, lay the foundation of the earth, and say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"
「我將我的手遮蔽你，我用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽定諸天，立定地基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。」
New American Standard says, "To establish the heavens."
新美國標準譯本（NASB）說：「為要建立諸天。」
The word 'establish' there, I looked it up in the New American Standard Study Bible, 'to establish the heavens' actually means to plant.
「建立」這個詞，我去查了新美國標準研讀本聖經，「建立諸天」其實是栽種的意思。
So I want you to think with me.
所以我要你們跟我一起思考。
"I put my words in your mouth, I've covered you with the shadow of my hand, because I want, through you, to plant the heavens and build solid foundations on the earth."
「我將我的話放在你們口中，我用我的手影遮蔽你們，因為我想要透過你們去栽定諸天，並在全地建立堅固的地基。」
This is an Old Testament warm-up for, "Yes, on earth as it is in heaven."
這是舊約時代的暖身，沒錯，就是為了「行在地上，如同行在天上」。
He's revealing the tool that He uses to release the reality of one world to rest upon the reality of another.
祂正在啟示祂用來釋放一個世界的真實、使其降臨在另一個世界的真實之上的工具。
He says, "I'm going to build strong foundations here, and then I'm going to plant that world where there's strong foundations."
祂說：「我要在這裡建立堅固的地基，然後我要將那個世界栽種在有堅固地基的地方。」
"I have put my words in your mouth, I've covered you with the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, lay the foundations of the earth, and say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"
「我將我的話傳給你，用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽定諸天，立定地基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。」
Moses interceded, "Oh, that all God's people were prophets."
摩西曾代禱：「惟願耶和華的百姓都是先知。」
Jesus talked about the prophets and the spiritual fathers of the Old Testament, they longed to see what we see.
耶穌談到舊約的先知和屬靈先賢時說，他們渴望看見我們所看見的。
I'd like to suggest to you that out of the ache of his heart, Moses was prophesying about the day that you and I live in, where all the people of God would be carrying prophetic anointing.
我想告訴你們，摩西出於他心中的迫切渴望，正預言著你我如今所生活的這個日子，在這樣的日子裡，神所有的子民都將帶著先知性的恩膏。
That is not, number one, self-serving.
這恩膏第一不是為了自私自利。
Number two, it is not to expose and tear down in this hour; it is to call out destiny.
第二，在這個時刻，它不是為了揭發和拆毀；它是為了呼喚出命定。
We've watched this now for years, where somebody will be caught up in a lie, maybe they believed about their whole life.
這幾年來我們一直看到這樣的情況：有人深陷在一個謊言中，也許是他們一輩子都信以為真的謊言。
In fact, we see this happen often now to people who don't even know the Lord.
事實上，我們現在常看到這種情況發生在甚至還不認識主的人身上。
They don't even know the Lord, and one of you will come along and just call out the gold in their life, and it completely changes them.
他們甚至還不認識主，而你們當中的某個人走過來，直接點出他們生命中的黃金，這就徹底改變了他們。
Because they've got this lie that they bought into for a lifetime, and somebody comes with one word of truth, and it completely changes their identity.
因為他們一直以來都買單了這個跟隨他們一輩子的謊言，然後有人帶著一句真理的話語來到，這就徹底改變了他們的身份認同。
Where they start living from a different place.
讓他們開始從一個截然不同的立足點來生活。
They move into—they repent, they turn from this, embracing what God has said about them.
他們進入——他們悔改，他們轉離這一切，去擁抱神對他們的宣告。
Every person in this room, the Lord has declared strong things, powerful things, positive things, corrective things, adjusting words.
在這房間裡的每一個人，主都曾對你們宣告過剛強的話、大能的話、正面的話、糾正的話、調整的話。
All these things have been declared over every one of us.
所有這些話都已經宣告在我們每個人身上。
And when we hear them, when we embrace them, they empower us to make changes that are impossible otherwise.
當我們聽見這些話，當我們擁抱這些話，它們就賦予我們能力，去做出原本不可能做出的改變。
And the Lord is inviting us into being a people that hear the voice of the Lord.
而主正在邀請我們，成為一群能聽見主聲音的子民。
If there's anything that is mocked in the earth right now, it is that you could actually hear God's voice.
如果說現在世上有什麼事是備受嘲笑的，那就是你竟然真的能聽見神的聲音。
這被人嘲弄，被人公開地嘲弄。

And I believe simply leaning in, every one of us has had the experience where, oh, we just randomly called a friend, and come to find out it was the exact moment of crisis, and they needed help, and we didn't know.
而我相信，只要單純地靠近祂，我們每個人都曾有過這樣的經歷：我們隨意打電話給一個朋友，結果發現那正是他們面臨危機的時刻，他們需要幫助，而我們事先並不知情。
那不是什麼如雷貫耳的聲音。
It wasn't, "Bill, call this number," you know, it wasn't that.
那不是：「比爾，打這支電話」，你們懂嗎，不是那樣的。
It wasn't a number appears on the wall and you punch that number out and you talk to... it's not that.
也不是牆上浮現出一串號碼，然後你按下號碼跟對方說話……不是那樣的。
It's the subtle leaning into a lifestyle of the presence of God, the Spirit of God.
那是種微妙的靠近，進入一種活在神同在、聖靈同在中的生活方式。
And you find yourself day after day after day bringing the word of the Lord, till it becomes a lifestyle where you think His thoughts, you declare His words.
然後你會發現自己日復一日地帶下主的話語，直到這成為一種生活方式，你會思想祂的想法，宣告祂的話語。
And it's not the strain and the effort of trying to hear from God.
那不需要為了努力聽見神的聲音而感到緊繃和費力。
I don't hear well when I try.
當我刻意去試的時候，我反而聽得不清楚。
I don't hear good at all when I try.
當我刻意去試的時候，我根本聽不好。
